summary: Iteration 37 - Verified 4 new features on Intercloud portal: (1) Proxmox templates listing + auto-discover clone (honest 400 when no template on live cluster); (2) MikroTik traffic source mapping on services; (3) Credit note PDF preview endpoint + UI button; (4) Welcome onboarding email logged when a client is created. critical_code_review_comments: AdminServices.jsx traffic-source-card: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered by dev-instrumentation (x-source-var wrapping). Not a functional bug - caused by dev overlay injecting <span style=display:contents> inside <option> - safe to ignore in prod build, but worth suppressing dev-instrumentation on <option> elements to keep console clean.

seed_data_creation: Created qa-onboard@example.com client user then deleted it (via test cleanup). One Proxmox provisioning attempt made (failed at auto-discovery step as expected - no VM created). No other side effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter37_features.py runs on preview URL with $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var + /api/portal prefix. Login field is 'token'. Credit note preview endpoint returns raw PDF bytes (not JSON) - the UI uses responseType=blob then window.open(blob URL). Traffic source PUT endpoint returns {ok, device, interface, sample, cleared?} - sample may be null when router unreachable (TEST_shared_router 127.0.0.1 is intentionally unreachable). Welcome email is enqueued during POST /admin/users; email_logs collection captures it even if SMTP is skipped in dev.
